issue.title: Batched memory selector rendering drops Children section for flat parent paths
issue.description: While verifying sase-ud.2, just check-full failed tests/memory/test_memory_selector_render.py::test_note_section_retains_children_listing_beneath_its_header. Focused repro still fails on the current tree. The resolved batch discovers notes with canonical paths like sase/memory/parent.md, but child frontmatter stores parent: parent.md, so render_children_section does not match the child when memory_selector_batch_markdown renders a multi-note batch.

task_type_fields.impact: sase memory read/show multi-note output can omit the required ## Children section beneath a selected parent note, so agents may miss required reference-memory child notes.

evidence.note: Independent reproduction during unrelated sase-ug.3 (projected-artifact-link-edges) work on 2026-08-26 at HEAD 20aa9fd2c: just test-scoped failed tests/memory/test_memory_selector_render.py::test_note_section_retains_children_listing_beneath_its_header with ValueError: substring not found ('## Children'). Confirmed pre-existing via git stash on a clean tree -- same failure with zero artifact-link changes applied.
